notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: Worst case, all layers holding KV: 64 layers x 8 KV heads x head_dim 128 (hidden_size 5120 / 40 attention heads) x 2 (K,V) x 2 B (bf16) = 262,144 B/token. Config layer_types is 48 sliding_attention (sliding_window 4096) + 16 full_attention, so past 4K tokens only the 16 global layers keep growing: 16 x 8 x 128 x 2 x 2 = 65,536 B/token of persistently-grown KV, plus a fixed ~4K-token window per sliding layer. Context 65,536 = max_position_embeddings (YaRN factor 8 over original_max_position_embeddings 8192).
